_about: Route dungeons (src/dungeon, src/states/overworld/dungeon.py). An area listed here is walked on a map instead of the route menu. floors: how many floors (stairs between them). style: field, forest or cave. size: [width, height] in tiles. wild: [fewest, most] wild Pokemon on a floor. loot: per_floor [fewest, most] loose items, and items {item: weight} (weights, not percents; POKE_BALLS go to the Poke Ball count). tm_spots: fixed TM spot ids (the TM in each is picked once per save, among the TMs not owned yet). Anything left out comes from DEFAULT.
